chasemaker.name: ChaseMaker
chasemaker.notes: First IFTK release (same binaries as GitHub v0.9.2). Needs EXRDemux.

cocainekenburns.name: CocaineKenBurns
cocainekenburns.notes: Light trails are baked into each picture (they ride with the photo, no pre-roll); Trail Horizontal/Vertical, Trails Follow Move, Trail Seed; new defaults (street-level streaks).

light_builder.name: Light Builder
light_builder.notes: Ctrl+Shift+L now stops the tool wherever the mouse is (before, only with the mouse over the 3D view). Esc still always stops it.

lightgroup_tools.name: Lightgroup Tools
lightgroup_tools.notes: Now installed and updated through IFTK.

noahaurorah.name: NoahAurorah
noahaurorah.notes: Shows at the top of the controls when a newer version is in IFTK. Expressions that pick a NoahAurorah control by number now point one control further down; by-name expressions are unaffected.

noahbevelah.name: NoahBevelah
noahbevelah.notes: Shows at the top of the controls when a newer version is in IFTK. Expressions that pick a NoahBevelah control by number now point one control further down; by-name expressions are unaffected.

noahelectrah.name: NoahElectrah
noahelectrah.notes: Core Glow, whole-number Forks/Strike Life/Seed/Loop Length, an Electrah mask to limit bolts, Blend Mode and new defaults, now on Mac and Windows.

noahfixah.name: NoahFixah
noahfixah.notes: First Windows build: Stabilize on the GPU (CUDA) and frame blending on DirectML. Renders are now repeatable under GPU load.

noahflarah.name: NoahFlarah
noahflarah.notes: New Blender Lights (AE Bridge) source with a Blender Lights import button. New defaults: Smoke Scale 150, Aspect 1 (saved layers keep their values).

noahflowah.name: NoahFlowah
noahflowah.notes: First Windows build, on the GPU (CUDA). The sim now matches on Mac and Windows; old 1.0 projects get a different swirl pattern with the same look.

noahglassah.name: NoahGlassah
noahglassah.notes: New: refractive glass logo effect (Classic MS6 look + reflections, frost, iridescence, dispersion, tint). Goes on an adjustment layer pointed at a hidden logo layer; read Documentation for setup.

noahglitchah.name: NoahGlitchah
noahglitchah.notes: The Mac catches up to Windows 1.1.0-b1. The look is unchanged.

noahglowah.name: NoahGlowah
noahglowah.notes: Windows now renders on the GPU (NVIDIA RTX 20 / GTX 16 or newer; other cards use the CPU). Mac is unchanged.

noahkaleidah.name: NoahKaleidah
noahkaleidah.notes: First release: Wedge, Tile (any lattice angle), Triangle Tile, Hex Tile and Spiral kaleidoscopes, with source spin and drift, Loop Frames, time variants, chromatic split, motion blur and Randomize. Metal on Mac, CUDA on Windows.

noahmappah.name: NoahMappah
noahmappah.notes: Windows now renders on the GPU (CUDA), like the Mac. Old projects look the same.

noahmatteandfillah.name: NoahMatteandFillah
noahmatteandfillah.notes: First release: one-click Fill and Matte renders (ProRes 422 or PNG) for the selected comp or still.

noahmovah.name: NoahMovah
noahmovah.notes: First release. GPU on Mac (Metal) and Windows (CUDA).

noahperspectah.name: NoahPerspectah
noahperspectah.notes: New Room modes (Back Wall, Corner) with their own floor and ceiling vanishing points, and GPU rendering on Mac and Windows.

noahpinnah.name: NoahPinnah
noahpinnah.notes: First release: corner pin from markers on the content's corners, on-screen pin handles, output grows past layer edges, Smooth supersampling. Metal on Mac, CUDA on Windows.

noahplexah.name: NoahPlexah
noahplexah.notes: Mac and Windows are on one version now: Rebuild Continuous, Lines Only default, Lock Over Time and Echo in 3D.

noahplotah.name: NoahPlotah
noahplotah.notes: Fix: projects made before 0.3 keep their old look (Contrast Blend opens at 0%). New copies start at 100%.

noahprojectah.name: NoahProjectah
noahprojectah.notes: First release. GPU on Mac (Metal) and Windows (CUDA).

noahrampah.name: NoahRampah
noahrampah.notes: Windows now renders on the GPU (CUDA), like the Mac. The look is unchanged.

noahrayah.name: NoahRayah
noahrayah.notes: Now runs on the GPU on Mac too (Metal), matching Windows 1.6.1 (CUDA): 2-4x faster than the CPU. Looks the same as before on both platforms.

noahreflectah.name: NoahReflectah
noahreflectah.notes: New Edge Mirror modes: Ellipse Mirror and Shape Mirror (moved in from NoahKaleidah), with the Surface controls applying to them. Mode is now at the top of the panel and every slider starts collapsed. Old projects render exactly the same. GPU on Mac (Metal) and Windows (CUDA).

noahripplah.name: NoahRipplah
noahripplah.notes: Windows now renders on the GPU (CUDA), like the Mac. Old projects look the same.

noahshadowah.name: NoahShadowah
noahshadowah.notes: First release. GPU on Mac (Metal) and Windows (CUDA).

noahshapah.name: NoahShapeah
noahshapah.notes: The whole frame now renders on the GPU on Mac and Windows, and is about 10x faster at high shape counts.

noahsharpah.name: NoahSharpah
noahsharpah.notes: Windows now renders on the GPU (CUDA), like the Mac. Old projects look the same.

noahshufflah.name: NoahShufflah
noahshufflah.notes: First release. GPU on Mac (Metal) and Windows (CUDA).

noahsingularitah.name: NoahSingularitah
noahsingularitah.notes: New Lens controls (Lens Strength, Lens Swirl). One black hole per closed mask, up to 32, sharing the same settings; a single mask looks the same as before.

noahsmokah.name: NoahSmokah
noahsmokah.notes: Now runs on the GPU on Windows too (CUDA), from the same engine as the Mac (Metal): about 0.75 s per 4K frame vs 1-2.6 s on the CPU. Old projects look the same (within 1 level). Brightness mode on the Mac GPU now keeps the layer solid where the smoke has gone, matching the Mac CPU and Windows; over non-black backgrounds, late frames of old Mac GPU Brightness renders change.

noahsortah.name: NoahSortah
noahsortah.notes: First release. GPU on Mac (Metal) and Windows (CUDA).

noahsparkah.name: NoahSparkah
noahsparkah.notes: Windows gets everything from b12-b15: per-instance sim caches, Layer Motion, Name Group and Blender Data emitters. Old projects look the same.

noahstarah.name: NoahStarah
noahstarah.notes: Streaks render on the GPU on Mac and Windows. Sharp Stars now use the CPU in GPU projects, which is faster in real renders.

noahstickah.name: NoahStickah
noahstickah.notes: NoahStickah 1.0 b3: Metal GPU path on the Mac (render on the GPU; analysis unchanged). Same pixels as the CPU path; old projects render unchanged.

noahstreakah.name: NoahStreakah
noahstreakah.notes: Fix: a layer bigger than its comp (or pushed off it) now renders in AE 2025.

noahstrokah.name: NoahStrokah
noahstrokah.notes: First release (experimental). Stroke around alpha with gradient rings, dashes, write-on, taper, distort and inner glow.

noahtypah.name: NoahTypah
noahtypah.notes: First release (experimental). Effect + style picker panel installed together. Needs IFTK 0.2.16 or newer for the panel.

noahupscalah.name: NoahUpscalah
noahupscalah.notes: First Windows build, on the GPU (DirectML and CUDA), about 10-20x faster than the CPU.

noahvibrah.name: NoahVibrah
noahvibrah.notes: Now renders on the GPU on Mac and Windows: about 4-8 ms a 4K frame, against 238 ms for Adobe Vibrance. Old projects look the same.

noahvignettah.name: NoahVignettah
noahvignettah.notes: Now renders on the GPU: Metal on Mac, CUDA on Windows, with the same look as before.

noahwaftah.name: NoahWaftah
noahwaftah.notes: New: Hold Above Paths (on for new applications). Older projects render exactly as before.

noahwrapah.name: NoahWrapah
noahwrapah.notes: The Mac catches up to Windows 0.3.0 and renders about twice as fast on the GPU.

noahwritah.name: NoahWritah
noahwritah.notes: First release: Text, Line Art and Shape modes, Fix Strokes. Windows runs on the CPU (fastest there).
